audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side is a flat "Skill" template on every row while content win[1,2,3,5]="Leona" and win[6]="Rakan" (matching the packet levelChart exactly, and matching content whys[] reasoning). Five rows disagreed.
audit.why: Content layer and the packet already carry the correct, kit-grounded verdict (instant E-Q beats his telegraphed W early/mid, his late mobility/peel wins level 6+2items); full layer was never updated off its generic template.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1,2,3,5].side to Leona and phases[6].side to Rakan, rewrote each .why to state the same reasoning already in the matching content whys[]. No content edits needed — win[] was already correct.

audit.why: Spikes correctly key level 2 (instant E-Q vs telegraphed W), level 6 (R charm evens it), first item (unmissable E re-takes control), late (his mobility/peel wins).
The one missingInteractions item (needs-antiheal off Gleaming Quill's heal) is already stated in report[8] Itemization ("Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain"), so no gap to fill.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: E-Q lands instant while his W telegraphs — you engage first and win the trade.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Unmissable E-lockdown beats his dodgeable dash — pick your window and land it.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: Reliable pin plus ADC follow-up keeps 4-5 lane control with you.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: First item: your E can't be dodged, so you retake control.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: Late, his superior mobility and double peel let him out-play your slower engage.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Grand Entrance is down 7-11s by rank — land your instant 875-range E in that window before he can re-engage.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Trading knockup for knockup at even tempo just resets his W — you gain nothing from the exchange.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Rakan's Grand Entrance (W, 14-10s by rank) starts every play — track him in fog; his E extends the knockup. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - His R (130/110/90s) is a swing moment, not a habit — spend yours to match it.
